problem.text: Meta Muse Spark Open (816B parameters in total, 42B active per token) is to be run for inference on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (128 GB configuration). The sources state that the model card gives 700 GB of VRAM required at NVFP4 (2000 GB at BF16), while the machine has 128 GB of nominal unified memory shared by CPU and GPU with no separate GPU memory, and the target proposes an 80 GB memory budget for the engine.

quotes.text: Build a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open that runs on NVIDIA DGX Spark.

property: vram_required, value: 2000, unit: GB, status: vendor_stated, source: "hf-model-card#weights", conditions: {precision: BF16}
capacity_nominal: {value: 128, unit: GB, status: vendor_stated, source: nvidia-dgx-spark-specs#system-memory}
CPU 与 GPU 共用同一个内存池，没有独立显存
80 GB is the one figure that is a budget for this machine.

uncertainties.description: The pass/fail context length is not given. The model allows 1,000,000 tokens; the target says the attention state comes from the same 80 GB budget and the engine cannot be sized until this value is given. The scope page does not give it.
uncertainties.clarification: What context length (in tokens) must the engine offer?

quotes.text: The attention state for the offered context is taken from the same 80 GB as the expert cache, so the engine cannot be sized until this is given.
The scope page does not give it.

uncertainties.description: The scope page names three memory figures (128 GB, 12 GB, 80 GB). The target proposes 80 GB as the budget, with decimal unit basis and its accounting boundary, all as proposals to be confirmed.
uncertainties.clarification: Is the memory budget 80 GB (decimal) in the unified pool, with the proposed accounting boundary?

quotes.text: The scope page names three figures.
12 GB is called a GPU working-set figure, and this machine has no separate GPU memory to apply it to.
The choice, the unit basis and the accounting boundary are proposals to be confirmed.

uncertainties.description: The quality task set and pass threshold are not named; the baseline and comparison rule are proposals.

readiness.reason: The purpose (a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA DGX Spark), the required text interface, container packaging, the judging target and the four required deliverables are stated, so Requirements can start without inventing the work. All listed uncertainties are missing or unconfirmed parameters (context length, thresholds, workload, form, environment, checkpoint, proposed budget) that Requirements can carry as unresolved items; none leaves the requested work unknown and no two required constraints contradict each other, so none is blocking.
